root_cause.text: A deadlock in ath12k_mac_op_flush() occurs because when flushing for the whole hardware (vif NULL), the function holds the wiphy lock while waiting for pending management transmission wiphy work to complete, but the work cannot run since it requires the same wiphy lock, causing mutual lock dependency.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description explicitly states the deadlock scenario: "Since wiphy lock has been taken by the flush process, the transmission work item has no chance to run, hence the dead lock." The patch moves the `wiphy_work_flush()` call before the early return for vif==NULL, ensuring the work is executed while the lock is still held (but the flush proactively runs the work).

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix missing flush of management TX work in ath12k flush operation to avoid race conditions and ensure proper synchronization.
intent_record.what: Added a loop for_each_ar(ah, ar, i) wiphy_work_flush(hw->wiphy, &ar->wmi_mgmt_tx_work) before the existing if (!vif) block in ath12k_mac_op_flush.
intent_record.how: This ensures that any pending management TX work (wmi_mgmt_tx_work) for each radio is completed before proceeding with the flush logic, preventing race conditions and ensuring all management frames are flushed.

intent_record.intent_summary: Remove the flush of management TX work during ath12k mac flush to prevent potential race conditions or deadlocks caused by flushing this work in that context.
intent_record.what: Removed two lines that looped over all active radios and flushed the wmi_mgmt_tx_work workqueue in the ath12k_mac_op_flush function.
intent_record.how: At runtime, the flush of pending management TX work for each radio is no longer performed during a mac flush operation, which may leave work items pending and could affect subsequent operations.
